create.name: Kelly Sullivan Walden
create.bio:
Kelly Sullivan Walden is an American dream worker and author, known to many as Doctor Dream, who teaches people to treat their night dreams as messages worth decoding and to bring that insight into the waking dreams they hope to realise. She holds a doctorate in spiritual counselling, is a certified clinical hypnotherapist, and has interpreted dreams on television and radio for many years. She has written eleven books, among them Dreaming Heaven, It's All in Your Dreams, two Chicken Soup for the Soul collections on dreams and I Had the Strangest Dream, as well as oracle decks and journals; her latest, Dreamifesting, pairs dreamwork with manifesting.

Her approach is warm and playful but structured. In one-to-one Zoom sessions she works through a remembered dream symbol by symbol and turns it into practical next steps. Dreamifesting, her twelve-week programme, is available as a recorded master class, and her DreamWork Practitioner Training teaches coaches and helpers her six-step method, lucid dreaming and work with difficult dreams across three modules. She records short guided meditations for bedtime, the chakras and setting intentions, and co-hosts a weekly radio show on dreams with Theresa Cheung, alongside her own YouTube conversations with other dream teachers.

courses.title: 1-on-1 Dream Deep Dive Session
courses.description: A private Zoom session in which she helps you decode a remembered dream and turn its message into practical steps. Longer packages of several sessions are also offered.

courses.title: DreamWork Practitioner Training
courses.description: A three-module certification for coaches and helpers in her six-step dreamwork process, dream interpretation, synchronicity and lucid dreaming, with meditations and a personal dream declaration.
courses.price: $3,009 USD (three modules; $2,400 USD paid in full)

courses.title: Dreamifesting Master Class
courses.description: More than seventeen hours of recorded teaching from her twelve-week Dreamifesting programme, on using dreams to clarify and pursue what you want to create in life.

courses.title: Guided Meditations
courses.description: A library of short downloadable meditations recorded by Kelly, for bedtime, each of the chakras, gratitude, intention setting and dream incubation.
